description: This Scala source file defines the LiteralValueProtoConverter object, which provides methods to convert Scala literal values to and from protobuf representations used in Spark SQL. It handles various data types, including primitives, dates, times, arrays, maps, and structs, and manages serialization/deserialization logic for Spark's internal data structures.

classes.name: LiteralValueProtoConverter
classes.description: Object providing conversion methods between Scala literals and protobuf representations for Spark SQL.

methods.name: setNullValue
methods.description: Sets the null value in the protobuf builder, optionally including data type information.

methods.name: toLiteralProtoBuilderInternal
methods.description: Recursively builds protobuf literal representation from Scala literal values, handling various data types.

methods.name: toLiteralProtoBuilder
methods.description: Creates a protobuf literal builder from a Scala literal value.

methods.name: toLiteralProtoBuilder
methods.description: Creates a protobuf literal builder from a Scala literal value with specified data type.

methods.name: setDataTypeForRootLiteral
methods.description: Sets the data type for the root protobuf literal, converting bytes to binary if needed.

methods.name: toLiteralProtoBuilderWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a protobuf literal builder with options, handling optional data type inference.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates a protobuf literal builder from a generic Scala value, using reflection if possible.

methods.name: toLiteralProto
methods.description: Converts a Scala literal to a protobuf literal.

methods.name: toLiteralProto
methods.description: Converts a Scala literal with specified data type to a protobuf literal.

methods.name: toLiteralProtoWithOptions
methods.description: Converts a literal to protobuf literal with specific options.

methods.name: toDataType
methods.description: Maps Java and Scala classes to Spark SQL DataType.

methods.name: toScalaValue
methods.description: Converts a protobuf literal back to a Scala value based on its data type.

methods.name: getScalaConverter
methods.description: Returns a function to convert protobuf literal to Scala value based on data type.

methods.name: isCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a protobuf literal type case is compatible with a Spark SQL data type case.

methods.name: getProtoDataType
methods.description: Extracts or infers the protobuf data type from a protobuf literal.

methods.name: toScalaArrayInternal
methods.description: Converts a protobuf array literal to a Scala array.

methods.name: toScalaMapInternal
methods.description: Converts a protobuf map literal to a Scala mutable map.

methods.name: toScalaStructInternal
methods.description: Converts a protobuf struct literal to a Scala GenericRow with schema.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Gets the Spark SQL DataType from a protobuf literal.
